![Mizuno 与强化箱子及木桶兼容材质](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cb10984e5592bdbae8a37289b4a4d6f1923fa07a.jpeg)

这是一个使 Mizuno 材质包与强化箱子及木桶模组兼容的纹理包。用原始的 Mizuno 纹理替换强化箱子及木桶的材质。

**必需前置**： [强化箱子](https://modrinth.com/mod/reinforced-chests) 或 [强化木桶](https://modrinth.com/mod/reinforced-barrels)
**我所有的 Mizuno 附加包** - [Mizuno 优化树叶](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mizuno-better-leaves) - [非官方 Mizuno 材质](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/unofficial-mizunos) - [Mizuno 连接纹理](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mizuno-connected-texture) - [Mizuno x Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mizuno-x-fresh-animations) - [Mizuno 深色模式](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mizunos-dark-mode) - [Mizuno 连接玻璃](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mizunos-connected-glass) -
